voice.name: Open Sector - Heavy Assimilator
voice.note: Shares the Heavy Assimilator voice designed for the Stalker (voices/stalker.json): no new custom voice. Its salvo is `fire`, as on the Nebelwerfer (the client's rocket shot falls back from sfx-rockets to sfx-fire), mastered hot like the other artillery.
voice.description: Enormous, slow machine voice of a giant legged alien war machine of a cyborg hive: very deep sub-bass layered voice, as if several huge synthetic voices speak at once an octave apart, grinding metallic overtones and a rumbling engine-like drone beneath every word, cold, emotionless and inevitable, each word heavy and deliberate with long pauses.

fire.prompt: Close, loud salvo of an alien organic rocket artillery launcher in an open field: six heavy hollow booming thumps of spore pods launching in rapid succession, each a deep powerful wet whump with a punchy bass kick, followed by a loud rushing whoosh as the pods tear away, no gunpowder, no music, no voice

move.prompt: Large legged alien artillery creature-machine walking forward: heavy hydraulic legs stepping in rhythm, deep thuds on dirt, organic pods rattling and sloshing on its back, servo whine and pneumatic hiss, close, no music, no voice

die.prompt: Alien rocket artillery machine destroyed: a heavy explosion followed by several organic spore pods bursting and popping in quick secondary wet blasts, crackling electric arcs, a dying synthetic drone winding down, medium distance outdoors, no music, no voice
